subject: CloudBridge vendor onboarding: DPA, subprocessor inventory & PO setup
messages:
From: Maya Rao <maya@cloudbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cloudbridge.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: CloudBridge — vendor setup docs for Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding window — excited to get set up as a supplier. Attached are the items you requested on the intake form:

- Signed DPA (attached: CloudBridge_DPA_signed.pdf)
- Current subprocessor inventory (attached CSV)
- W9 (attached)
- Permanent link to our latest SOC 2 report: https://secure-audit-hosting.example.com/reports/cloudbridge/SOC2-report-2026.pdf

A few notes: our subprocessor list includes AWS (us-east-1), S3 backups via DataSync Inc., and a logging provider (LogStream LLC). If you need additional attestations on any subprocessor, let me know and I’ll loop in security.

We also need a PO to proceed with provisioning and to set up billing. If you can confirm the required fields for the PO (billing address, tax ID to be used, expected start date), we’ll start the provisioning once the PO is issued.

Thanks — attaching everything as PDFs/CSV.

—
Maya Rao
Head of Partnerships
CloudBridge, Inc.
maya@cloudbridge.com | +1 415-555-0112
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge — vendor setup docs for Redwood Inference

Hi Maya — thanks for sending these over and for the clear checklist. I’m putting Procurement/Finance and Security on copy to complete the intake. Quick questions to make sure the PO has everything:

- Billing name / remit address (for PO & AP)
- Vendor tax ID (if different from the W9 header)
- Preferred remit method (ACH / wire / check)
- Start date for services (we will put provisioning date on the PO)

Rishi and Karthik — can you confirm whether the attached DPA aligns with our standard terms (or whether Legal needs to redline)? Also please verify the SOC 2 link and whether any subprocessor (DataSync Inc.) requires further review.

Maya — once internal approvals are green, I’ll send a DocuSign PO and a short onboarding checklist for technical provisioning.

Best,
Soohyun (Soojin) Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0207
From: Maya Rao <maya@cloudbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CloudBridge — vendor setup docs for Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — answers below inline: 

- Billing name / remit address: CloudBridge, Inc., 420 Market St, Suite 230, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Tax ID: 94-1234567 (matches W9)
- Remit method: ACH preferred (we will provide account details on secure portal)
- Service start date: target provisioning week of 2026-12-20

We confirm the attached DPA is the signed master DPA from our side. If Redwood needs any redlines, please send them and we’ll review quickly.

Let me know if you need any more supporting evidence on subprocessors — happy to provide network diagrams or contact for DataSync security lead if required.

—
Maya
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: CloudBridge — vendor setup docs for Redwood Inference

Soojin — I reviewed the DPA and the SOC2 link. Quick summary:

- SOC 2 report: link is valid, independent auditor attestation present, no open exceptions in 2026 report.
- DPA: standard with CloudBridge; commercial terms are fine but Section 6.3 references subprocessor flow-down — I want confirmation that DataSync Inc. receives the full-encrypted dataset or only metadata.
- Subprocessor CSV lists DataSync Inc. as 'backup & transfer' — request to CloudBridge: confirm scope of data handled and whether backups are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys.

If CloudBridge confirms encryption at rest + limited access, I’m comfortable recommending that Procurement issue the PO with the standard Redwood privacy addendum. If they don’t confirm, we should require a short security addendum.

Karthik — can you prepare PO template with terms: Net 30, Redwood PO number placeholder, ACH remit instructions to be attached? Laura, please flag for AP to expect new vendor W9.

Rishi
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procure@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: PO/DocuSign next steps — CloudBridge (PO# RDW-2026-0581)

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick responses. Per Rishi’s note, can you confirm the following in reply to this thread:

1) DataSync Inc. will only handle encrypted backups; backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and keys are customer-not-accessible (CloudBridge uses KMS, customer-managed BYOK is available).
2) No other subprocessors will have access to raw customer data.

Assuming that confirmation, we will issue PO RDW-2026-0581 with Net 30 terms. I’ve started the DocuSign envelope for the PO and Redwood privacy addendum — link below for signature. Please sign both the DocuSign PO and the attached DPA if needed.

DocuSign (PO + privacy addendum): https://docusign.example.com/embedded/abc123-cloudbridge

Attachments in the envelope: PO_RDW-2026-0581.pdf, Redwood_Privacy_Addendum.pdf

Next steps after signatures: AP will request final invoice against PO number and we’ll confirm provisioning week of 2026-12-20.

Thanks — cc’ing Laura for AP intake.

Best,
Soohyun (Soojin) Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
